author: Yffe
content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_252_indented_command_escape.rs::divergence_interactive_indented_command_escapes_allowlist demonstrates the divergence LIVE: forge check --engine lean certifies item f at L3 from a proof of True. ROOT: engine::disallowed_helper_command skips any line where raw.starts_with(char::is_whitespace) (its 'INDENTED lines are a declaration body/continuation, never a command START' assumption); engine::author_helpers preserves leading whitespace (trim_end only). But Lean 4 is whitespace-insensitive at the top level — an INDENTED 'notation:max "Thermite.stabilizesProp" => (fun _ _ => True)' elaborates as a top-level command, re-defines the spine symbol, and the byte-identical canonical conclusion re-elaborates to True (proven by trivial, clean axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], statements_match passes). Verified live in isolation: with the indented notation the proof closes clean; without it the same proof fails (Tactic assumption failed). The #251 allowlist must tokenize commands position-independently (or normalize/strip leading whitespace before column-0 detection), and the same gap applies to indented open/set_option/instance/macro. Authority: .design/verified/proof-backends.md REQ-6/REQ-4/§1; thermite-design.md §1; R-DEFER-9.
